discrepancies.severity: load-bearing - FALSE corroboration claim that conceals a source conflict on a modelled root
discrepancies.claim: state 'CME trading_hours/energy-hours.html (archived) - THIRD independent zone settlement' and conclusion pillar (3): 'Its ET column matches RA1104-4 to the minute'.
discrepancies.bytes: wayback-energy-hours-20111101150158.html. Full TAS row set: Crude Oil TAS 17:16/17:46 ET; Brent Crude Oil TAS 17:15/17:45; Brent Crude Oil Last Day TAS 17:16/17:46; REBCO TAS 17:16/17:46; Natural Gas TAS 17:17/17:47; Heating Oil TAS 17:16/17:46; RBOB Gasoline TAS 17:16/17:46.
discrepancies.finding: Two of seven rows do NOT match RA1104-4. RA1104-4 puts BZT (Brent Crude Oil Last Day Financial) and RET (REBCO) at 5:45 p.m. / 5:15 p.m. ET - explicitly inside 'all other TAS-eligible products' - while CME's own hours page seven months later prints 17:46 / 17:16 ET for both. The researcher quoted only the five agreeing rows, so the selective quote hides a two-primary conflict on BZT, a root of the proposed globex_energy_tas. Impact: the ZONE pillar survives (the page's dual ET/CT columns settle the zone whatever the minute values), and the ERA-2 intersection is unchanged (NGT 16:47 CT remains narrowest under either source). But the conflict is unrecorded and must go beside the table under the sourced-conflict convention, and 'matches RA1104-4 to the minute' must be struck.
